mentions.name: telegram-auto-translate
mentions.description: A Telegram bot that uses Claude Opus 4.5 to automatically translate outgoing messages, enabling users to hold detailed conversations and debates in languages they don't speak.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I wrote a Telegram translate bot that uses Opus 4.5 for outgoing messages.

Super simple, yet it’s already good enough that I’ve had detailed conversations and debates in languages that I don’t speak at all.

https://github.com/aimoda/telegram-auto-translate
